text: dsh-tiered-compaction 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的分层上下文压缩插件。它通过 Bundle Patch 接管 compaction，并以无损折叠、工具输出落盘、软压力驱逐和有损摘要逐级释放上下文空间；配套界面展示压力、使用量和各层统计。适合希望减少冗余上下文并保留大型工具输出恢复路径的 DSH 用户。落盘目录默认位于 ~/.dsh/tiered-archive；摘要层使用会话模型。

dsh-tiered-compaction adds four-stage context compaction to DSH Web: repeated-line folding, tool-output archiving, pressure-based eviction, and model summarization. Its interface shows context pressure and tier activity. Archives default to ~/.dsh/tiered-archive.

dsh-tiered-compaction README · tiered-compaction：**让上下文先被整理，再决定是否调用 LLM。** DSH 的分层上下文压缩插件：折叠 → 落盘 → 驱逐 → 摘要，前三层不调用 LLM，只有压力真正到阈值时才进入摘要。 [](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [](https://github.com/2849236173/tiered-compaction/releases) [](LICENSE) [](package.json) [简体中文](README.md) · [English](README.en.md) > 当前正式版：**0.4.1**。正式版适合日常使用；beta 版本可能包含新修复或新功能，但**未完全测试通过**。

dsh-tiered-compaction README · 30 秒看懂：普通压缩往往等到压力已经很高才一次性处理历史。`tiered-compaction` 把处理动作按成本从低到高排成四层：先做无损整理，再做可恢复的空间回收，最后才把 LLM 调用放在真正需要的位置。

| 层 | 发生什么 | LLM 成本 | 能否找回 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| **1 · 折叠** | 连续重复 3 次以上的行折叠成一行 | 0 次 | 原文语义不变 |
| **2 · 落盘** | 超过 8 KB 的工具输出存到本地，当前上下文只留预览和路径 | 0 次 | 存档可读回 |
| **3 · 驱逐** | 70% 提醒收束，80% 移除旧的可重跑工具结果 | 0 次 | 重跑原命令 |
| **4 · 摘要** | 压力到阈值（约 82%）时摘要较早的历史 | 1 次 | 摘要前原文存档 |

dsh-tiered-compaction README · 和“一次性摘要”有什么不同？：| | 一次性摘要 | `tiered-compaction` |
|---|---|---|
| 触发方式 | 压力高了才处理 | 从低成本层开始逐步处理 |
| 前三层 | 通常直接进入模型摘要 | 不调用 LLM |
| 工具输出 | 容易和对话历史一起挤占窗口 | 大结果先落盘，保留预览与路径 |
| 恢复方式 | 依赖摘要是否准确 | 存档读回或重跑原命令 |
| 宿主接入 | 等待官方默认策略 | 通过 DSH Bundle Patch 接入压缩链 |
section: 和“一次性摘要”有什么不同？

dsh-tiered-compaction README · 它在 DSH 里长什么样：悬浮窗把当前上下文压力、实际 token 用量、三类无损/可恢复处理次数，以及距离下次摘要的距离放在对话旁边；设置页提供更详细的分层统计。
- 大号百分比是当前上下文占窗口的比例；右上角显示实际 token 用量和距下次摘要还差多少。 - 三张卡片分别统计折叠/落盘、驱逐、摘要的次数和省下的 token。 - 摘要进行中显示「正在摘要… Ns」。 - 会话空闲时，压缩会等下一条消息触发，悬浮窗会显示「下条消息时自动压缩」。

dsh-tiered-compaction README · 安装：插件分两档发布，选一个安装：

| 档位 | 适合谁 | npm 标签 |
|---|---|---|
| **正式版** | 希望稳定使用的大多数用户 | `latest` |
| **beta 尝新版** | 愿意尝试新修复、新功能并反馈问题的用户 | `beta` |

**安装正式版：**

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-tiered-compaction@latest
```

**安装 beta 版：**

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-tiered-compaction@beta
```

命令最后可能出现 `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`。这是 pnpm 跳过了一个只打印提示的安装脚本，插件本身已经装好，可以忽略。

安装后完全退出 DSH 再打开，不需要手动改配置。Web、命令行、TUI 可以把 `desktop` 换成 `web`、`headless`、`tui`。

dsh-tiered-compaction README · 安装：> beta 不一定比正式版新。正式版发布后，beta 标签可能还停在更早的版本；安装前可先查看两个标签：
>
> ```powershell
> npm view dsh-tiered-compaction dist-tags
> ```

dsh-tiered-compaction README · 让四层全部生效：DSH 的每个会话在创建时绑定一个预设，之后不能更换。只安装插件时，所有会话都有第 1、2 层，第 3、4 层仍使用官方压缩。要四层全部开启，需要把预设换成本插件的版本：

| 预设 | 开启方式 |
|---|---|
| `cordis`（桌面端默认） | 安装 `tiered-cordis-preset` bundle |
| `ptc-tc` | `tools/generators/gen-ptc-tc.ps1 -Apply` |
| `standard`（Bot 和群聊使用） | `tools/generators/gen-standard-tc.ps1 -Apply` |
| 官方 `ptc`、`minimal` | `tools/generators/gen-standard-tc.ps1 -Preset ptc -Apply`，`minimal` 同理 |

修改后只有**新开的会话**会生效，已有会话保持原样。DSH 升级后需要重新运行一次生成器。

dsh-tiered-compaction README · 确认它在工作：在宿主日志中搜索 `tiered-compaction 健康`：

```text
tiered-compaction 健康 window=262144 pressure=57.3% ... status=ok
```

`status=ok` 表示正常；`status=warn` 后面会写明发现的问题。

dsh-tiered-compaction README · 更新、切换和卸载：更新和切换档位都使用 `add` 加标签，重新执行一次即可：

| 想做什么 | 命令 |
|---|---|
| 正式版升到最新正式版 | `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-tiered-compaction@latest` |
| beta 版升到最新 beta | `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-tiered-compaction@beta` |
| 从正式版切换到 beta | `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-tiered-compaction@beta` |
| 从 beta 切回正式版 | `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-tiered-compaction@latest` |
| 卸载并恢复官方压缩 | `dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-tiered-compaction` |

dsh-tiered-compaction README · 更新、切换和卸载：不要使用 `update`：安装时记录的是确切版本号，`update` 不会跨过它升级，也不会在两档之间切换。

执行后完全退出 DSH 再打开。确认当前安装版本：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop list dsh-tiered-compaction
```

dsh-tiered-compaction README · 配置：所有字段都可选，不填写就使用默认值：

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 是否接管压缩 |
| `auto` | `true` | 是否自动压缩；`false` 时只能手动 `/compact` |
| `archiveDir` | `~/.dsh/tiered-archive` | 存档目录 |
| `summaryTarget` | 跟随会话 | 摘要使用的 `provider` 和 `model` |
| `modelPolicies` | 无 | 按模型覆盖阈值和重试次数 |
| `scopeId` | 不填 | 预设挂载时使用，生成器会自动填写 |

dsh-tiered-compaction README · 已知限制：- 含图片或附件的工具结果不处理。
- 落盘预览固定为 5120 字符，完整原文在存档中。
- 当前按 DSH 0.2.x 的压缩接口实现；DSH 大版本升级后需要重新核对。

dsh-tiered-compaction README · tiered-compaction：**Organize context first. Spend an LLM call only when it is truly needed.**

A tiered context compaction plugin for DSH: fold → spill → evict → summarize. The first three tiers make no LLM calls; summarization starts only when pressure reaches the threshold.

[](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[](https://github.com/2849236173/tiered-compaction/releases)
[](LICENSE)
[](package.json)

[简体中文](README.md) · [English](README.en.md)
dsh-tiered-compaction README · tiered-compaction： > Current stable release: **0.4.1**. Stable is recommended for daily use. Beta may include new fixes or features but is **not fully tested**.

dsh-tiered-compaction README · See it in 30 seconds：A one-shot compaction waits until pressure is high and then processes history at once. `tiered-compaction` orders work from low cost to high cost: lossless cleanup first, recoverable space reclamation next, and an LLM call only at the edge.

dsh-tiered-compaction README · See it in 30 seconds：| Tier | What happens | LLM cost | Recovery |
|---|---|---:|---|
| **1 · Fold** | Three or more consecutive repeated lines collapse into one | 0 calls | Lossless |
| **2 · Spill** | Tool output over 8 KB moves to disk; the active context keeps a preview and path | 0 calls | Read the archive |
| **3 · Evict** | A reminder at 70% pressure; old re-runnable tool results leave at 80% | 0 calls | Re-run the command |
| **4 · Summarize** | Older history is summarized when pressure reaches the threshold (about 82%) | 1 call | Original history is archived |

dsh-tiered-compaction README · Why not just summarize once?：| | One-shot compaction | `tiered-compaction` |
|---|---|---|
| Trigger | Wait until pressure is high | Progress through low-cost tiers first |
| First three tiers | Often goes straight to a model | No LLM calls |
| Tool output | Competes with conversation history for space | Large output spills first, with a preview and path retained |
| Recovery | Depends on summary accuracy | Read the archive or re-run the original command |
| Host integration | Uses the default strategy | Integrates through a DSH Bundle Patch |

dsh-tiered-compaction README · What it looks like in DSH：The HUD puts context pressure, actual token use, the count of three processing classes, and the distance to the next summary beside the conversation. The settings page shows the same information with more detailed per-tier statistics.
section: What it looks like in DSH

text:
dsh-tiered-compaction README · What it looks like in DSH：- The large percentage is the share of the context window in use; the top right shows actual token usage and the distance to the next summary.
- Three cards count fold/spill, eviction, and summary runs, including tokens saved.
- While a summary runs, the HUD shows “Summarizing… Ns”.
- When a session is idle, compaction waits for the next message and the HUD says so.

dsh-tiered-compaction README · Install：The plugin ships in two release tracks. Pick one:

| Track | For | npm tag |
|---|---|---|
| **Stable** | Most users who want a tested default | `latest` |
| **Beta** | Users willing to try new fixes/features and report issues | `beta` |

**Install stable:**

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-tiered-compaction@latest
```

**Install beta:**

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-tiered-compaction@beta
```

dsh-tiered-compaction README · Install：The command may end with `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`. pnpm skipped an install script that only prints a message; the plugin itself is installed and you can ignore it.

Fully quit and reopen DSH after installation. No manual configuration is needed. For the web app, CLI, or TUI, replace `desktop` with `web`, `headless`, or `tui`.

dsh-tiered-compaction README · Install：> Beta is not always newer than stable. After a stable release, the beta tag may still point to an older version. Check both tags before installing:
>
> ```powershell
> npm view dsh-tiered-compaction dist-tags
> ```

dsh-tiered-compaction README · Enable all four tiers：Each DSH session binds to a preset when it is created and keeps that preset. With only the plugin installed, every session gets tiers 1 and 2, while tiers 3 and 4 stay with the official compaction. To enable all four tiers, switch the preset to this plugin's version:

dsh-tiered-compaction README · Enable all four tiers：| Preset | How |
|---|---|
| `cordis` (desktop default) | Install the `tiered-cordis-preset` bundle |
| `ptc-tc` | `tools/generators/gen-ptc-tc.ps1 -Apply` |
| `standard` (used by Bots and group chats) | `tools/generators/gen-standard-tc.ps1 -Apply` |
| Official `ptc`, `minimal` | `tools/generators/gen-standard-tc.ps1 -Preset ptc -Apply`, and the same for `minimal` |

Only **new sessions** pick up the change; existing sessions keep their preset. Re-run the generators after upgrading DSH.

dsh-tiered-compaction README · Check that it works：Search the host log for `tiered-compaction 健康`:

```text
tiered-compaction 健康 window=262144 pressure=57.3% ... status=ok
```

`status=ok` means healthy. `status=warn` is followed by what went wrong.

dsh-tiered-compaction README · Update, switch, uninstall：| Goal | Command |
|---|---|
| Stable → newest stable | `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-tiered-compaction@latest` |
| Beta → newest beta | `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-tiered-compaction@beta` |
| Stable → beta | `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-tiered-compaction@beta` |
| Beta → stable | `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-tiered-compaction@latest` |
| Uninstall and restore official compaction | `dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-tiered-compaction` |

dsh-tiered-compaction README · Update, switch, uninstall：Do not use `update`: installation records an exact version, and `update` neither moves past it nor switches tracks.

Fully quit and reopen DSH afterwards. To see the installed version:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop list dsh-tiered-compaction
```

dsh-tiered-compaction README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Take over compaction |
| `auto` | `true` | Compact automatically; with `false`, only manual `/compact` |
| `archiveDir` | `~/.dsh/tiered-archive` | Archive directory |
| `summaryTarget` | Session's model | `provider` and `model` used for summaries |
| `modelPolicies` | none | Per-model threshold and retry overrides |
| `scopeId` | unset | Used when mounted in a preset; generators fill it in |

dsh-tiered-compaction README · Known limits：- Tool results containing images or attachments are left alone.
- Spill previews are fixed at 5120 characters; the full text is in the archive.
- The current implementation targets the DSH 0.2.x compaction interface; recheck after a major DSH upgrade.
